name: Launch LMS design system
scope: Current product foundations and shared UI; classification is descriptive, not a claim that every surface conforms.

foundations.name: Background
foundations.role: Page canvas; default dark blue-slate #131F24, light #F5F8F9

foundations.name: Shell
foundations.role: Outside surface around the navigation/content pane and coach

foundations.name: Raised
foundations.role: Lifted controls and hover fill on cards

foundations.name: Edge
foundations.role: Darker underside that makes pressable surfaces read as pressable

foundations.name: Plan color
foundations.role: A plan's color, set by planVars() on [data-plan]; with --plan-edge, --plan-deep and --plan-accent

components.name: Button
components.notes: Pressable brand (org accent), plan (plan color via --plan-* variables) and surface variants share one shape: 16px radius, caps label, a 4px edge that collapses on press. Former cta/ctaSecondary are brand/surface with size cta.

components.name: Card
components.notes: Includes product-specific interactive, subtle, filled, and flat variants.

patterns.name: Unstable candidate banner and panels
patterns.role: Full-width authenticated candidate entry point for unread platform announcements, merge notes, and Jira-backed feedback, with anchored desktop panels and a mobile bottom tray outside the normal learner and admin layouts.

patterns.name: Product page titles
patterns.role: Central Feature | Detail naming, safe route fallbacks, and dynamic entity registration for browser tabs and provenance.

patterns.name: Subtle scrollbar
patterns.role: Low-contrast scrollbar that becomes visible when its scroll region is hovered or focused.

patterns.name: Coach header
patterns.role: Conversation navigation with a chevron that tucks Coach to show the page and an X that ends the conversation; a focused-session bar discloses scope, an editable goal and an explicit End control.

patterns.name: Coach shell (open, edge, closed)
patterns.role: Coach lives beside the page on the outside surface: desktop keeps navigation and scrolling content inside a rounded pane filling the space up to the resizable panel; phones slide the page aside to a strip. Once a chat starts, tucking leaves a pull-out edge with an unread dot. Fixed surfaces start below the tester and demo bars and sit under menus and dialogs.

patterns.name: Plan path
patterns.role: A plan's steps as path nodes (done, current breathing, open, locked) in the plan color; only the selected step expands into a card with Start and Ask Coach, the rest stay one line. Plan views open scrolled to the next step.

patterns.name: Plan header carousel
patterns.role: The open plan's deep-color header among the learner's plans: phones swipe with neighbours peeking, wider screens show the other plans as spines.

patterns.name: Discover search bar
patterns.role: Full-width search with a filter button; filters live in its menu and appear as removable chips only once applied. A search or filter switches Discover to its results view.

patterns.name: Discover hero
patterns.role: Featured stories that advance on a segmented timer; hover, focus and touch pause, swipes move between stories, reduced motion turns autoplay off.

patterns.name: Portfolio settings menu
patterns.role: Phone-only settings button on the learner's portfolio header holding Account, Messages, Organizations, Appearance, Help and Sign out, with an unread dot; wider screens keep these in the side navigation.

patterns.name: General content wrapper
patterns.role: Responsive content shell with a wide option for editorial pages; primary navigation stays anchored in the shared 1600px frame within the content pane

patterns.name: Content page header
patterns.role: Back navigation (explicit destination or callback), centered title, tabs, or progress

patterns.name: Legacy modal wrapper
patterns.role: High-use wrapper over the shared Dialog primitive

patterns.name: Legacy form kit
patterns.role: Parallel form controls that overlap components/ui

patterns.name: Legacy confirmation modal
patterns.role: Direct Radix confirmation flow overlapping Dialog

patterns.name: Demo bar
patterns.role: One 48px bar above the product during a demo. Visitor variant (indigo): Demo/Unstable tags, demo-user menu (switch, start over, add time, end), Guide, Feedback, Announcements (when there are any). Setup variant (dark striped, LIVE tag): admin signed in as a real demo account, with Guide, Publish and Back to Studio. Replaces the unstable tester bar while shown. Reuses Button, Popover and Dialog.

standards: Search this catalog and the product source before adding a component or layout.
Prefer an adopted shared primitive when it supports the required behavior.
Record why an adopted component does not fit before introducing a replacement.
Promote reusable additions into shared product code and add them to this manifest.
Exercise relevant loading, empty, populated, error, disabled, keyboard, light, dark, tenant-brand, and responsive states.
Add a design-system conformance check to every UI delivery task before product review.
